description.value: Fish & Rice is a Japanese sushi restaurant in downtown Pemberton opened in 2017 by chef Koji Miyagawa, a Sea to Sky local with nearly three decades of culinary experience. The menu spans traditional sashimi, specialty rolls, Japanese appetizers, and cooked entrees in a cozy sushi bar setting. The restaurant has earned a TripAdvisor five-star rating and 'Best of Pemberton' recognition, making it a notable stop for cyclists passing through the Sea to Sky corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at fish-and-rice.com is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM address (102-7433 Frontier St, including unit 102 per OSM addr:unit tag) and adds the phone number (604) 894-0016 absent from OSM tags. Takeout is explicitly stated on the front page ('Take out available'), and the menu page explicitly notes 'Gluten free options available' with multiple vegetarian items (Vegetable Gyoza, Avocado rolls, Cucumber rolls, Edamame, etc.). No evidence anywhere—OSM or website—for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenity.
concerns: Phone number (604) 894-0016 is present on the website but absent from OSM tags — OSM record should be updated to include the phone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, well-reviewed sit-down restaurant in downtown Pemberton offering dine-in and takeout with GF and vegetarian options — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists on the Sea to Sky corridor.
